question: When and how should one begin chanting the eight-syllable mantra?
premises: The practice begins on the bright twelfth lunar day.
The eight-syllable mantra is then chanted.
inference: After fasting, one should begin chanting the eight-syllable mantra on the bright twelfth day.
plain_english: Having fasted, one should begin on the bright twelfth day and chant the eight-syllable mantra.
